report:
Independent non-author Gemini 4 Argon High source-attribution review of the packet-v2 Rust Cardano backend navigation map (`/home/charl/moriarty-c2-opus55-restored-20261017/backend-map/review-packet`).

### 1. Scope and Coverage
All packet manifests (`MANIFEST.json`, `SOURCE-MANIFEST.json`, `PACKET-MANIFEST.json`), `ROOT-STRUCTURE-CHECK-V2.json` (treated strictly as mechanical checks, not an approval), `README.md`, the complete `graph.json` (1,646 lines, 68 nodes, 64 edges), `SOURCE-BUNDLE-V2.json`, and all 16 full frozen source bodies (`S01` through `S16`) were read in full and cross-checked without executing code, running builds/tests, or accessing external paths.

### 2. Falsifiable Predicate Verification
- **Manifest and Hash Consistency:** `checkout_head` (`54fc7a1a54106245abb1a5ef6e16407464e1b654`), `packet_manifest_sha256` (`c1225791c698711a34279f308cfd85262728e56580f8ca776cb211b1a0b65d73`), file paths, byte counts, and SHA-256 digests match across `MANIFEST.json`, `SOURCE-MANIFEST.json`, `PACKET-MANIFEST.json`, `SOURCE-BUNDLE-V2.json`, and `graph.json`.
- **Exact Line and Excerpt Attribution:** All 68 nodes and 64 edges in `graph.json` match the exact 1-indexed line numbers and literal text of the cited frozen files (`S01`–`S16`).
- **End-to-End Call Chain and Branch Membership:**
  - CLI entrypoint `mori-k2` (`S01-README.md:3`) -> `main` (`S02-main.rs:42`) -> `run` (`S02-main.rs:53,137`) dispatches on `"compile"` (`S02-main.rs:140`) and `"inspect"` (`S02-main.rs:149`).
  - Both branches call `input::read_source` (`S02-main.rs:142,152` -> `S03-input.rs:48`), `json_bytes` (`S02-main.rs:102-103`) -> `input::read_bounded` (`S03-input.rs:28`), `input::parse_selector` / `input::parse_request` (`S02-main.rs:143,153` -> `S03-input.rs:123,132`) -> `input::parse_json` (`S03-input.rs:54,59`), and `compile_selected` (`S02-main.rs:144,154` -> `S04-relation.rs:258`).
  - The `"inspect"` branch then calls `inspect::inspect` (`S02-main.rs:156` -> `S05-inspect.rs:155`), which calls `claim::prepare_claim` (`S05-inspect.rs:159`, boundary) and `inspect::receipt` (`S05-inspect.rs:160` -> `S05-inspect.rs:119`).
  - `relation::compile_selected` calls `check_selector` (`S04-relation.rs:259` -> `S04-relation.rs:31`) and `mori_r1cs::compile_source::<Fr>` (`S04-relation.rs:268`).
  - `S07-lib.rs:62` re-exports `circuit::{..., compile, compile_source}`, and `S16-circuit.rs:266` supplies the `compile_source` body.
  - `compile_source` calls `frontend::admit_source(source)` (`S16-circuit.rs:267` -> `S06-frontend.rs:35`), which calls `mori_core::language` (`S06-frontend.rs:36`), `mori_core::parse` (`S06-frontend.rs:41`), `admit_checked` (`S06-frontend.rs:42` -> `S06-frontend.rs:57`, calling `mori_core::stage::require_core1` at line 58 and `mori_core::validate` at line 59) to return `Admitted::Core1`, or `mori_core::stage::load` (`S06-frontend.rs:45`) to return `Admitted::Staged2` (`S06-frontend.rs:46`).
  - `compile_source` branches on `Admitted::Core1(admitted)` (`S16-circuit.rs:268`) to call `compile::<F>` (`S16-circuit.rs:212`), and on `Admitted::Staged2(staged)` (`S16-circuit.rs:269`) to call `staged.lowering_plan()?` for the `CompileError::StagedNotLowered` refusal.
  - `circuit::compile` calls `options.compiler.checked` (`S16-circuit.rs:220`), `adapter.admits` (`S16-circuit.rs:221`), conditionally `abi2::options_ok` (`S16-circuit.rs:223` under `if adapter == StatementAdapter::SettlementHashV2` at line 222), `plan::plan_action` (`S16-circuit.rs:225` -> `S08-plan.rs:255`), `StatementLayout::build` (`S16-circuit.rs:226`), conditionally `abi2::constants` (`S16-circuit.rs:255` under `if adapter == StatementAdapter::SettlementHashV2` at line 254), and `probe::<F>` (`S16-circuit.rs:260` -> `S16-circuit.rs:275`).
  - `circuit::probe` calls `synthesize` (`S16-circuit.rs:279` -> `S16-circuit.rs:418`), and `circuit::synthesize` calls `lower::lower_action` (`S16-circuit.rs:463` -> `S09-lower.rs:159`).
- **Uninspected Boundaries & No Invented Edges:** External Core functions (`mori_core::language`, `mori_core::parse`, `mori_core::stage::load`, `mori_core::stage::require_core1`, `mori_core::validate`) and unbundled module calls (`claim::prepare_claim`, `options.compiler.checked`, `adapter.admits`, `abi2::options_ok`, `StatementLayout::build`, `abi2::constants`, `staged.lowering_plan`) are accurately typed as boundary nodes with zero invented outgoing edges and explicitly listed in `metadata.remaining_uninspected_boundaries` and `README.md`.
- **Specimen Links and Quoted Assertions:** Invoice (`S10`, `S12`, `S14`) and reserve (`S11`, `S13`, `S15`) nodes and edges record only literal CLI flags (`S01-README.md:46-47,50-51`), action declarations (`partial` at `S10:21`, `allocate` at `S11:8`), selector/request `"action"` strings (`S12:5`, `S13:5`, `S14:7`, `S15:7`), and `"kind": "CoreReference"` (`S14:14`, `S15:14`) without inferring UTxO-family coverage. Profile distinctions (`Source/6 + Core/5` vs `moriarty/1 + moriarty-core/1`) and dated evidence caveats (`S01-README.md:112`) are properly classified as `QUOTED_SOURCE_ASSERTION`.

### 3. Limitations
This review establishes source attribution only for the 16 frozen files in the review packet. It does not inspect external Core or unbundled crate modules, and it does not establish cryptographic soundness, constraint completeness, source-semantic equivalence, runtime/build/test behavior, operator readiness, or Cardano ledger acceptance. All security evaluation remains reserved to Opus 5.5.
